# lakekeeper_projects (Data Source)

The `lakekeeper_projects` data source lists the projects the provider's identity can see, sorted by name. With an authorizer such as OpenFGA, Lakekeeper filters the list by the caller's permissions.

**Upstream API**: [Lakekeeper REST API docs](https://docs.lakekeeper.io/docs/nightly/api/management/#tag/project/operation/list_projects)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lakekeeper_projects" "all" {}

# Projects by name, for example to look up each organization's project.
locals {
  project_ids = { for p in data.lakekeeper_projects.all.projects : p.name => p.id }
}
```
